summary: Results workbook for VD-19-120, the DT18 benzofuran acetamide route transfer for Doventhar Therapeutics. It compares crystallisation and chromatography work-up for the shared intermediate, records the purity of the 40-analogue delivery lot, and notes that the crystallisation route supported Doventhar's outsourced follow-up batch.

properties.title: VD-19-120 DT18 route transfer and delivery results

sheets.name: Summary

rows.v: VD-19-120 DT18 benzofuran acetamide, route transfer

rows: Crystallisation replaces chromatography for the shared intermediate. The route transfers to the Doventhar team as written.
Crystallisation needs the seed from the first lot. Doventhar's batch will need a fresh seed if the lot is run from a new supplier of the acid.

sheets.name: Route transfer
rows: Recovery accepted for the first runs. Slow, and solvent-heavy on the larger scale.
Ethanol/water, cool slowly from reflux, filter
Replaces the column. Crystals filter cleanly. Purity gain is as good or better in the HPLC.
Ran in Nottingham. Seeded, no oiling out.
Passed. Shared intermediate goes through crystallisation for all the remaining members.

sheets.name: Delivery lot

rows.v: Analogues delivered to Doventhar Therapeutics, lot 3

rows: Yield is isolated. Purity is HPLC area % at 254 nm. Amounts are delivered mg per compound.

comments.text: Lot 3 release sign-off pending the Doventhar QC report.
